events.text:
T-058 prep is built and committed, but nothing is launched or published yet. I set the task to doing and acked F-a4339d5e.

- **Built:** a launch kit, a one-page connect guide, and a Replies column on the referral dashboard for each member and the team total. The kit has each member's code and links and a draft campaign config with the T-057 caps. The caps Bharath has to record are still a placeholder.
- **Checked:** the referral tests passed and the dashboard probe passed 14 of 14. I did not look at a screenshot of the new column. The probe's test data has no outreach figures, so it only exercises the not-connected fallback.
- **Not published:** I couldn't build the live dashboard data here because there's no Google credential in this run. The mirror and board publish will happen on the next ops tick.
- **Still gated:** launch waits on Bharath's T-057 sign-off with caps and the T-056 import. After that each member connects their own profile.
- **Risk:** I haven't confirmed that Tantra campaigns accept a per-contact first line (T-059), so the draft config says so.
- **Plan slots:** the Pro plan shows 2 of 2 LinkedIn accounts in use, so a third profile needs a slot added first.

Files are in `workshop-plan/outreach/`:
- `launch-kit.md`
- `connect-linkedin-guide.md`

I also edited `workshop-plan/referrals.html`, `workshop-plan/ops/referrals.py` and `workshop-plan/ops/outreach.json`.
